parole.testo: From Low German bedǖren, compare German beteuern. Derived from the adjective dǖr, from Proto-Germanic *diurijaz, cognate with English dear, German teuer, Norwegian Bokmål dyr.

parole.significato: a bun; a small, usually round baked good, especially a soft, sweet yeast bun
parole.testo: Borrowed from Low German bolle (“round object; round wheat bread”), continuing Middle Low German bolle (“round object”), from Old Saxon bollo (“bowl, cup”), from Proto-Germanic *bullô (“round object; ball; bowl”).
